meta.name: toolhive-release
meta.description: Creates ToolHive release PRs by analyzing commits since the last release, categorizing changes, recommending semantic version bump type (major/minor/patch), and triggering the release workflow. Use when cutting a release, preparing a new version, checking what changed since last release, or when the user mentions "release", "version bump", or "cut a release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析提交记录并生成版本发布PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版前都要手动整理变更和版本号
copy.tagline_en: Automate release PR generation from commit analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compile changes and bump versions before each release

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动分析 ToolHive 项目自上次发布以来的所有提交，将变更分类（新功能、修复、破坏性变更等），推荐合适的版本号（主版本/次版本/补丁），并创建发布 PR。
howto.when: 当你提到“发布”、“版本号”、“cut a release”等关键词，或要求检查自上次发布以来的变更时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看自上次发布以来有哪些变更？
say.note: Claude 会列出提交并分类。

say.text: 准备发布一个新版本，建议用次版本还是补丁？
say.note: Claude 会分析变更并推荐版本号。

say.text: 触发一个次版本发布的 PR。
say.note: Claude 会先分析，等你确认后执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically analyze all commits since the last release in the ToolHive project, categorize changes (new features, fixes, breaking changes, etc.), recommend a semantic version bump (major/minor/patch), and create a release PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "release", "version bump", "cut a release", or ask to check what changed since the last release.

say_en.text: Show me what changed since the last release.
say_en.note: Claude will list and categorize commits.

say_en.text: I want to cut a new release. Should it be minor or patch?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and recommend a version bump.
Claude will analyze first, then wait for confirmation.
